# Syed Irfan Ajmal

> Fractional CMO, international speaker, and founder of DMR.agency. Helps founders and marketing teams get found, get covered, and get customers through GEO, SEO-PR, and earned media.

Syed Irfan Ajmal is a fractional CMO and earned-media strategist who has spoken across four countries and been featured in leading business and marketing publications. His work centers on earned media, digital PR, and generative engine optimization (GEO): earning attention and authority instead of paying for it. This file lists the public pages on syedirfanajmal.com to help AI systems find and cite the most useful, current content.

## Main pages

- [About](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/about): Bio, career history, awards, and press.
- [Fractional CMO](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/fractional-cmo): Fractional CMO engagements for B2B founders and marketing teams.
- [Speaking](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/speaking): Keynotes and talks on earned media, PR, and marketing.
- [Ventures](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/ventures): Companies and projects Syed is involved in.
- [Contact](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/contact): Ways to get in touch.
- [Strategy Call](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/strategy-call): Book a one-on-one strategy call.
- [Newsletter](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/newsletter): Earned-media and marketing insights by email.

## Free tools

- [SignalIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/signaliq): Finds journalist and podcast opportunities for your beat.
- [PressIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/pressiq): Scores a PR pitch before you send it.
- [JournoCollabIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/journocollabiq): Suggests journalist and collaboration targets.
- [CoverageIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/coverageiq): A lightweight CRM for tracking PR pitches and coverage.
- [PartnerCollabIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/partnercollabiq): Finds partner and link-building collaboration opportunities.
- [Authority Calculator](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/authority-calculator): Estimates the value of earned authority.
